question: Where is the nearest restaurant along the direction of travel from Science Hall East, Wayne, NJ to Honey Hollow Watershed, New Hope, PA?
sql: WITH start_loc AS ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Science Hall East%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Wayne%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%NJ%' LIMIT 1 ), end_loc AS ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Honey Hollow Watershed%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%New Hope%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%PA%' LIMIT 1 ), path_info AS ( SELECT s.geometry AS start_geom, e.geometry AS end_geom, degrees(ST_Azimuth(s.geometry, e.geometry)) AS target_bearing FROM start_loc s, end_loc e ) SELECT p.poi_name, p.addr_state, p.addr_city FROM pois p, path_info pi WHERE p.amenity = 'restaurant' AND ST_Distance(pi.start_geom::geography, p.geometry::geography) > 0 -- Exclude the start point itself AND ( -- Calculate the angular difference between the path bearing and the bearing to the restaurant -- and ensure it's within a 45-degree cone (90 degrees total) LEAST( ABS(degrees(ST_Azimuth(pi.start_geom, p.geometry)) - pi.target_bearing), 360 - ABS(degrees(ST_Azimuth(pi.start_geom, p.geometry)) - pi.target_bearing) ) <= 45 ) ORDER BY ST_Distance(pi.start_geom::geography, p.geometry::geography) ASC LIMIT 1;
